milestones.title: Foundation: Vite+React+TS+Tailwind, profile + 2 link cards, galaxy bg, favicon/OG/dark-bg/noscript, deploy
milestones.note: Code complete + verified (19 tests, build green): scaffold, LinkCard/ProfileHeader/App, links w/ simple-icons, index.html (dark bg/OG/fonts/noscript), SVG favicon, GalaxyBackground (pure stars.ts model + DPR canvas, CSS nebula). milestones.title: Water ripples: ripple canvas above bg/below fg, background-only tap detection, theme-tinted concentric rings
milestones.note: Code complete + verified (42 tests, build green): pure ripples.ts model (createRipple 2-3 staggered rings, advance/radius/alpha/expiry, isBackgroundTap ignoring a/button/[data-no-ripple]) + RippleCanvas.tsx (z-0 between -z-10 bg and z-10 fg, pointer-events-none, window pointerdown listener, accent-tinted strokes via --accent, on-demand rAF loop that idles when no rings). Wired into App. Next: M3 themes (Matrix+Rainbow bgs, theme orb, crossfade, localStorage).

milestones.title: Themes: Matrix + Rainbow backgrounds, theme orb (bottom-right, idle bob), crossfade + orb pulse, accent var + rainbow scrim, localStorage persistence
milestones.note: Done so far + verified (full suite 72 tests, build green): theme.ts model + ThemeContext (provider hydrates/persists localStorage, mirrors data-theme + --accent vars). NEW this run: pure matrix.ts model (GLYPHS katakana+digits, randomGlyph, columnCount, createColumns staggered above screen, advanceColumn fall+recycle, glyphIntensity head=1 fading trail) + MatrixBackground.tsx (DPR canvas, per-cell glyph grid, white-ish head + green fading trail, shimmer, .matrix-bg black base). Not yet wired into App. NEXT: RainbowBackground.tsx (CSS conic, reduced-motion), then ThemeOrb (bottom-right idle bob, cycle on click, theme-reflecting skin, pulse, a11y), crossfade between the 3 bgs driven by useTheme, rainbow-only dark scrim + stronger card frost.
